text:
alex.w: Starting router weight shift to v2.3.1 across eu-west. Quiet window 22:00-23:00 UTC. Will do 10%->25%->50%->100% every 5m, pause for metrics. Tagging SRE @mira.k @sam.g

deploy-bot: Initiating weighted shift: target release:v2.3.1, initial weight 10%, steps [10,25,50,100], step_interval=300s. Rollback hook: /ops/rollback v2.3.0

mira.k: I'll watch p95 and error rate. Please pin session cookie on edge? Otherwise session drift might skew canary.

alex.w: Good call. I'll pin by adding header 'X-Route-Pin: v2.3.1' for canary cohort and set cookie TTL 30m. Command: `routerctl set-pin --cohort canary --version v2.3.1`

sam.g: Can we avoid regional fanout? keep eu-west only. Also ensure fallback to v2.3.0 is immediate. Ops runbook: `kubectl exec -c router -- /scripts/fast-rollback.sh v2.3.0`

deploy-bot: Health check results for v2.3.1 in shadow are OK: 1000 reqs sampled, latency +2% p95, errors 0.2% (<0.5% threshold).

jen.p: :eyes: will monitor logs for NPEs — added eval set 'smoke_prompt_set_17' to quality checks.

alex.w: Starting step1 -> 10% now.

deploy-bot: Traffic weights updated: v2.3.0=90%, v2.3.1=10% (eu-west).

mira.k: p95 is stable, error rate 0.22%, no alerts. continuing to 25% in 5m. :thumbsup: 

alex.w: Note: pinned cookies applied. Also updating release-notes channel: 'v2.3.1: routing fix + kv-cache tweak' — docs link: https://redwood/release/v2.3.1

sam.g: If we see error spike >0.8% or latency +20% from baseline, we execute rollback command and pin back to v2.3.0. Who's on-call for rapid rollback? @mira.k

mira.k: I'm on-call. If rollback needed I'll run fast-rollback and notify infra to drain new pods.

deploy-bot: Next weight change scheduled in 4m 58s. Reminder: change window ends at 23:00 UTC.

alex.w: If everything green at 50% we'll proceed to 100% and then unpin after 1h to avoid long sticky sessions.

jen.p: Adding post-shift regression job to run after 1h.

deploy-bot: Shift complete: v2.3.1=100% in eu-west at 1734567910.

alex.w: Unpinning now. Command: `routerctl unset-pin --cohort canary`

mira.k: All metrics look good. Closing window. Great job team. :tada:

sam.g: Adding note to release thread about rollback hooks and pin TTL.
